overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to approve minutes timely and by failing to provide draft open-session minutes within 10 days; notice and deliberation claims were rejected.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the notice for the December 14, 2015 meeting was not properly posted.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, the Board properly posted notice of this meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged, based on the December 14 discussion, that Board members deliberated on the removal permit outside a meeting.
allegations.key_passage: After investigation, we find no evidence that the Board deliberated outside of a meeting and therefore find no violation in this regard.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board's minutes are generally inaccurate.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, we decline to review the allegation that the Board's minutes are generally inaccurate.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged matters discussed at the October 26, 2015 meeting were introduced on December 14 after that meeting's notice was improperly posted.
allegations.key_passage: violation can reasonably be discovered at the time it occurs

allegations.summary: Board failed to approve its October 26, 2015 and December 14, 2015 meeting minutes in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: Here, although the Board met on a monthly basis, it did not approve its December 14, 2015 meeting minutes until four months later, on April 11, 2016.

allegations.summary: Board failed to provide the draft October 26, 2015 minutes within 10 days of the complainant's December 17, 2015 request.
allegations.key_passage: it violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to make them available within 10 days of a request

allegations.summary: Complainant's request also sought non-minutes documents, which the complainant claims the Board did not respond to properly.
allegations.key_passage: Our review concerns only compliance with the Open Meeting Law

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Approve the October 26, 2015 meeting minutes, if not already done, within 30 days of receipt of the letter.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law. Additionally, we order the Board to approve the October 26, 2015 meeting minutes, if it has not already done so, within 30 days of receipt of this letter.
